info.name: NexAris Data (no API)
info.description:
NexAris does not use a backend API. The site reads static JSON data files directly from a public Cloudflare R2 bucket (read-only, CORS open to any origin). No authentication is needed.

These requests are plain file downloads (GET), useful for checking the data the Space Agent can read.

Data base URL: https://pub-26ea368373434497ab9344264e063a9a.r2.dev
Live site: https://nexaris-cyan.vercel.app

variable.description: Sky tile number. Take a real value from movers/index.json.

request.description: Index of the SPHEREx movers data (lists the available sky tiles). Start here.

All movers in one sky tile. Returns { movers: [...] }. Each mover has a class: known (known asteroid), tracklet (unidentified mover), slow (barely moving) or single (unconfirmed, 1 visit). Set the npix variable to a tile number from the index.
Which parts of the sky have SPHEREx data.
